name: Wettringen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Wettringen (red lozenges and a figure on white).
history: Municipal flag of Wettringen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wettringen arms — lozenges and figure on white
